name: vibeue
description: Inspect and bind UMG Widget Blueprints through the VibeUE Unreal Engine MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and bind UMG Widget Blueprints
interface.longDescription: Resolve Widget Blueprints, inspect UMG hierarchies and Blueprint graphs, and register MVVM ViewModels and bindings through the VibeUE MCP server running inside the Unreal Editor.
defaultPrompt: Use $umg-inspect-bind to inspect this Widget Blueprint and apply the requested bindings.
Use $umg-mvvm-binding to register the ViewModel and MVVM bindings described above.
